checks.text: The page displays the heading "Bullet Journal" and a month grid where the button for the 15th of the current month is labelled "15".
Clicking the button "15" in the month grid selects that day, and the text "Tasks for 15" appears in the checklist section header.
Typing "Buy milk" in the input labelled "New task" and pressing Enter adds a checklist item with the text "Buy milk" and an unchecked checkbox; the progress indicator shows "0/1".
Clicking the checkbox for the item "Buy milk" marks it as complete, changes its text to "Buy milk" with a strikethrough style, and updates the progress indicator to "1/1".
Typing "Read book" in the input labelled "New task" and pressing Enter adds a second item; the progress indicator shows "1/2".
Clicking the button "Move up" next to the item "Read book" moves it above "Buy milk"; the first item in the list is now "Read book".
Clicking the button "Delete" next to the item "Read book" removes it from the list; the progress indicator reverts to "1/1" and only "Buy milk" remains.
Clicking the button "16" in the month grid changes the checklist header to "Tasks for 16" and shows the text "No tasks yet" because no items exist for that date.
Reload keeps the task "Buy milk" for the 15th; after reloading, selecting the 15th shows the item "Buy milk" with a checked checkbox and progress "1/1".
